headline.purpose: The one page title: 1.5rem, 1.875rem from 640px. Featured novel title on home is 1.25rem / 1.5rem.

title.purpose: Heading of each card or section.

card-title.purpose: Novel titles in cover cards and list rows; rank and chapter numbers use the same serif at 1.125rem bold, muted.

wordmark.purpose: Site name: 1.25rem in the sidebar, 1.125rem in the top bar.

ui.purpose: Sidebar items, sub-headings under a page title, sheet list rows; 600 when current.

synopsis.purpose: Novel page synopsis, max 42rem. Home teaser is 0.9375rem at 1.85.

prose.purpose: Chapter text; size adjustable through --reader-font-size, 1.6em between paragraphs, 40rem measure; reader may switch to serif.

label.purpose: Muted metadata, chips, counts, secondary links, small group headings (600).

caption.purpose: Dates, rating counts, chapter counts, footer.

shadows.name: card-shadow
shadows.purpose: Every card at rest in light; none in dark and sepia. var(--card-shadow).

shadows.name: lift-shadow
shadows.purpose: Cover card on hover; large covers at rest. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); sepia: rgba(67,52,34,0.35). var(--lift-shadow).

motion.name: tap
motion.value: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease
motion.purpose: Press feedback on every tappable control; scale(0.97) while active. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: cover-zoom
motion.purpose: Cover scales to 1.03 when its card is hovered.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled accent action in a card, e.g. start reading.

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like an installed reading app. A fixed shell (sidebar on desktop, top bar and five bottom tabs on phones) holds a grey ground on which white cards sit: a featured novel, a ranked chart, latest chapters, a grid of cover cards, and on chapter pages one large reading card. Ratings, likes, views and reactions are first-class content, shown as small counts beside a star, a heart or an eye rather than as decoration.

Density is app-like but not crowded: 16px card padding, 24px between cards, lists divided by hairlines inside their card. Everything interactive answers a touch (a 3% press-in) and the reading surface keeps tall Sinhala line heights. Light is the default theme; dark is pure black with neutral greys; sepia is a reading option. Every colour comes from the theme variables so the three themes stay in step.
keyCharacteristics: Two-tone grounding: a tinted app ground with panel-coloured cards, bars and sidebar on top.
One card class for every container (14px corners, 1px border, a near-invisible shadow in light only).
App shell: 16rem sidebar from 1024px; sticky top bar plus five bottom tabs below it; a reader bar replaces the tabs while reading.
Teal accent for the primary action, the current tab and the next step; amber for stars and rose for likes are the only other colours in the chrome.
Serif (Noto Serif Sinhala) names things; sans (Noto Sans Sinhala) is for everything operated or read at length.
Phone order is source order; wide screens rearrange the same sections into a main column and a 21rem side column.

rules.name: The Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Dark means #000000 ground and neutral greys. No navy, slate or blue-tinted grey anywhere in the dark theme, including borders and muted text.

rules.name: The Three Signals Rule
rules.body: Teal means act or you-are-here, amber means rating, rose means liked. Nothing else in the chrome takes a colour; covers supply the rest.

rules.name: The Inverted Chip Rule
rules.body: A selected filter chip is ink on panel reversed (ink fill, panel text), not accent. The accent stays free for actions.

rules.name: The Serif Names Things Rule
rules.body: Serif is for titles of works, page and card headings, rank numbers and the wordmark. Buttons, navigation, metadata and small group headings stay sans.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card must read as a card with its shadow removed, because in dark and sepia it is. Never rely on a shadow alone to separate a surface from the ground.

rules.name: The Covers Lift Rule
rules.body: The lift shadow belongs to covers and to cover cards under a pointer. Bars, the sidebar, buttons and list cards stay flat.

dos: Do put content in cards on the app ground: panel background, 1px theme border, 14px corners, 16px padding.
Do use the theme variables (`--reader-*`, `--theme-accent*`, `--star`, `--like`, `--card-shadow`, `--lift-shadow`) for every colour and shadow so light, dark and sepia all work.
Do keep dark at pure black ground with neutral greys.
Do design the phone layout first and let source order be the phone order; add the side column at 1280px.
Do give every tappable control the press feedback and a hit area of at least 36px, 44px for standalone buttons.
Do draw icons from the single icon set at 1.8 stroke in the current text colour, and fill them only to show a pressed state or a rating.
Do show real numbers only: a dash for an unrated novel, zero for no likes.
Do keep bars clear of device edges with the safe-area inset and reserve room so the bottom bar never covers content.
donts: Don't use navy, slate or any blue-tinted grey in the dark theme.
Don't hard-code colours in markup; the reader-sheet theme swatches are the single exception because they preview other themes.
Don't colour anything in the chrome except with teal (action, current), amber (rating) and rose (liked).
Don't use the accent for selected filter chips or the current sidebar item; those use ink and ground.
Don't separate a card from the ground by shadow alone, or add shadows to bars, the sidebar or buttons.
Don't use emoji as icons. Emoji appear only as the chapter reaction choices.
Don't set buttons, navigation or metadata in the serif.
Don't introduce a second card style, radius or border weight for containers.
